---
title: "High School 5K Times: Freshman vs. Senior Year"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

# Read the 2,000-runner dataset, keeping 5K time strings as text
xc_raw <- read_csv(
  "hs_5k_2000_runners.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    freshman_5k_time = col_character(),
    senior_5k_time = col_character()
  )
)

# Reshape into one row per race (Freshman and Senior) with matching year and time
xc_long <- bind_rows(
  xc_raw |>
    transmute(
      athlete_id,
      name,
      gender,
      grade = "Freshman",
      recorded_year = freshman_year,
      five_k_time = freshman_5k_time,
      time_seconds = freshman_seconds,
      time_minutes = freshman_seconds / 60
    ),
  xc_raw |>
    transmute(
      athlete_id,
      name,
      gender,
      grade = "Senior",
      recorded_year = senior_year,
      five_k_time = senior_5k_time,
      time_seconds = senior_seconds,
      time_minutes = senior_seconds / 60
    )
)

# Helper to build an interactive stacked dotplot with a right-side info box
make_interactive_dotplot <- \(data, target_gender, plot_title, card_id) {
  binwidth <- 0.2

  # Stack Freshman dots (bottom) and Senior dots (top) in 0.2-minute bins
  dots <- data |>
    filter(gender == target_gender) |>
    mutate(
      x_bin = round(time_minutes / binwidth) * binwidth,
      grade = factor(grade, levels = c("Freshman", "Senior"))
    ) |>
    arrange(x_bin, grade, time_seconds) |>
    mutate(stack_y = row_number(), .by = x_bin)

  fr_dots <- filter(dots, grade == "Freshman")
  sr_dots <- filter(dots, grade == "Senior")

  p <- plot_ly(height = 600) |>
    # Trace 0: Blue Freshman dots
    add_markers(
      data = fr_dots,
      x = ~x_bin,
      y = ~stack_y,
      name = "Freshman",
      customdata = ~paste(athlete_id, name, five_k_time, recorded_year, "Freshman", sep = "||"),
      hoverinfo = "none",
      marker = list(color = "blue", size = 6)
    ) |>
    # Trace 1: Red Senior dots
    add_markers(
      data = sr_dots,
      x = ~x_bin,
      y = ~stack_y,
      name = "Senior",
      customdata = ~paste(athlete_id, name, five_k_time, recorded_year, "Senior", sep = "||"),
      hoverinfo = "none",
      marker = list(color = "red", size = 6)
    ) |>
    layout(
      hovermode = "closest",
      hoverdistance = 15,
      title = list(
        text = paste0(
          plot_title,
          "<br><sup>2,000 dots total: hover over a dot to see runner details and make their other dot glow</sup>"
        ),
        x = 0,
        y = 0.97
      ),
      xaxis = list(title = "5K Time (Minutes)", zeroline = FALSE),
      yaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 0.98, yanchor = "top"),
      margin = list(t = 95, r = 10, b = 50, l = 15),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    ) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
    onRender(
      "function(el, x, cardId) {
        var box = document.getElementById(cardId);
        // Add 3 concentric glow traces (indices 2, 3, 4) for the partner dot
        Plotly.addTraces(el, [
          { type: 'scatter', mode: 'markers', x: [], y: [], showlegend: false, hoverinfo: 'skip',
            marker: { color: '#ffd700', size: 26, opacity: 0.35 } },
          { type: 'scatter', mode: 'markers', x: [], y: [], showlegend: false, hoverinfo: 'skip',
            marker: { color: '#ffee00', size: 16, opacity: 0.75 } },
          { type: 'scatter', mode: 'markers', x: [], y: [], showlegend: false, hoverinfo: 'skip',
            marker: { color: '#ff2222', size: 9.5, line: { color: '#ffffff', width: 2 } } }
        ]);

        // Index all Freshman (trace 0) and Senior (trace 1) coordinates by athlete_id
        var lookup = {};
        [0, 1].forEach(function(tIdx) {
          var tr = el.data[tIdx];
          for (var i = 0; i < tr.x.length; i++) {
            var parts = tr.customdata[i].split('||');
            var id = parts[0];
            if (!lookup[id]) lookup[id] = {};
            lookup[id][tIdx] = { x: tr.x[i], y: tr.y[i] };
          }
        });

        el.on('plotly_hover', function(ev) {
          var pt = ev.points[0];
          if (pt.curveNumber > 1) return;
          var parts = pt.customdata.split('||');
          var id = parts[0], name = parts[1], time = parts[2], yr = parts[3], grade = parts[4];

          // Show hovered dot's runner name, 5K time, and year in the right-side box
          box.innerHTML =
            '<div style=\"font-weight:700; font-size:0.98rem; margin-bottom:6px; color:#1b3b24;\">' + name + '</div>' +
            '<div style=\"font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:3px;\"><b>5K Time:</b> ' + time + '</div>' +
            '<div style=\"font-size:0.9rem;\"><b>Year:</b> ' + yr + ' (' + grade + ')</div>';

          // Find and glow the runner's equivalent dot in the other grade
          var partnerTrace = pt.curveNumber === 0 ? 1 : 0;
          var partnerColor = partnerTrace === 1 ? '#ff2222' : '#2266ff';
          var partner = lookup[id] && lookup[id][partnerTrace];
          if (partner) {
            Plotly.restyle(el, {
              x: [[partner.x], [partner.x], [partner.x]],
              y: [[partner.y], [partner.y], [partner.y]]
            }, [2, 3, 4]);
            Plotly.restyle(el, { 'marker.color': [partnerColor] }, [4]);
          }
        });

        el.on('plotly_unhover', function() {
          Plotly.restyle(el, { x: [[], [], []], y: [[], [], []] }, [2, 3, 4]);
        });
      }",
      data = card_id
    )

  # Side-by-side layout: plot on the left, small info box on the right
  div(
    style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%;",
    div(style = "flex: 1; min-width: 0;", p),
    div(
      id = card_id,
      style = paste(
        "width: 210px; flex-shrink: 0; padding: 12px 14px;",
        "background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #b7d4c0; border-radius: 8px;",
        "box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-size: 0.9rem; color: #4a6350;"
      ),
      "Hover over any dot to see the runner's name, 5K time, and year."
    )
  )
}
```

## Average 5K Times (Freshman vs. Senior)

```{r}
# Calculate average 5K times in minutes and format as MM:SS
xc_long |>
  summarize(
    avg_seconds = mean(time_seconds),
    .by = c(gender, grade)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    avg_time = sprintf(
      "%d:%02d (%.2f min)",
      floor(avg_seconds / 60),
      round(avg_seconds %% 60),
      avg_seconds / 60
    )
  ) |>
  select(Gender = gender, grade, avg_time) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = grade, values_from = avg_time) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Women's 5K Times (Freshman vs. Senior)

```{r}
#| column: body-outset
make_interactive_dotplot(
  xc_long,
  target_gender = "Women",
  plot_title = "Women's High School 5K Times: Freshman vs. Senior Year",
  card_id = "women-runner-box"
)
```

## Men's 5K Times (Freshman vs. Senior)

```{r}
#| column: body-outset
make_interactive_dotplot(
  xc_long,
  target_gender = "Men",
  plot_title = "Men's High School 5K Times: Freshman vs. Senior Year",
  card_id = "men-runner-box"
)
```

## Summary

Comparing the two distributions reveals a clear difference in average 5K time improvement between men and women from freshman to senior year. Men improved substantially on average, dropping **1 minute and 12 seconds** from **19:34** as freshmen to **18:22** as seniors (with 87% of male runners recording a faster senior time, visible in the clear leftward shift of the red dots). In contrast, women showed a much smaller average improvement of **9 seconds**, moving from **22:36** to **22:28** (with 59% running faster as seniors and the freshman and senior distributions largely overlapping).

**Data Source:** Ohio High School Athletic Association (OHSAA) District Cross Country Championship results (2011–2020), archived on [Baum's Page](https://www.baumspage.com/cc/index.php).
